## Mengo Hospital - Nursing Apprenticeship Programme

**Mengo Hospital** is one of Uganda's oldest and most respected healthcare institutions, located in **Mengo, Kampala**. With a long tradition of compassionate care and clinical excellence, Mengo Hospital continues to invest in the training and development of healthcare professionals.

## Take the Next Step in Your Nursing Career

Are you a nurse looking to **boost your skills and confidence** with real clinical practice? Mengo Hospital is offering a **specialized nursing apprenticeship programme** designed to give nurses hands-on experience in high-demand clinical areas.

## 6-Month Specialized Tracks

Choose one of the following specialty tracks to deepen your expertise:

### 1. Critical Care (ICU/HDU)
- Patient management in Intensive Care and High Dependency Units
- Monitoring and interpreting vital signs and clinical indicators
- Ventilator management and advanced life support skills
- Care of critically ill patients including post-operative and trauma cases
- Infection prevention in high-acuity settings

### 2. Dialysis
- Renal care principles and dialysis system operations
- Haemodialysis machine setup, monitoring and maintenance
- Patient assessment and care before, during and after dialysis sessions
- Management of dialysis complications and emergencies
- Nutritional and fluid management for renal patients

### 3. Emergency Care
- Trauma assessment and rapid response nursing
- Triage and prioritization of emergency patients
- Management of medical and surgical emergencies
- Basic and advanced cardiac life support
- Stabilization and preparation of patients for transfer or admission

### 4. Ophthalmic Nursing
- Support for eye surgery procedures and post-operative care
- Pre-operative patient preparation and assessment
- Instrument handling and theatre setup for ophthalmic procedures
- Patient education on eye care and medication adherence
- Infection prevention in ophthalmic settings

### 5. Inpatient Care (Medical)
- Comprehensive medical patient management
- Medication administration, monitoring and documentation
- Chronic disease management including diabetes, hypertension and HIV
- Patient and family education on disease management
- Coordination with multidisciplinary healthcare teams

### 6. Inpatient Care (Surgical)
- Pre-operative and post-operative patient care
- Wound care, drain management and pain assessment
- Monitoring for post-surgical complications
- Patient mobilization and rehabilitation support
- Surgical theatre preparation and instrument handling

## Who Should Apply

- Registered nurses who want to gain specialized clinical experience
- Nurses looking to transition into critical care, dialysis, emergency or ophthalmic nursing
- Nursing professionals who want to build confidence and competence in high-demand areas
- Nurses seeking career advancement through practical, hands-on training

## What You Will Gain

- Real clinical practice under experienced mentors and specialists
- Hands-on experience in a busy, reputable hospital setting
- A certificate of completion for the specialized apprenticeship track
- Enhanced employability and readiness for specialized nursing roles
- Networking opportunities with experienced healthcare professionals

## How to Apply

Submit the following to the **Office of the Superintendent of Nursing, Mengo Hospital**:

- Application letter
- Certified copies of academic documents

📞 **Phone:** +256 772 510 270

🌐 **Website:** mengohospital.org

## Deadline

All applications must be received by **4th September 2026**.
